<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin="par117" />e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=37}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=51|verse=14}} ({{GHGheb|text=סָמַךְ}}); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=19|verse=5}} ({{GHGheb|text=סָעַד}}); ''to do something to one'', {{GHGheb|text=גָּמַל}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=50|verse=15}}, 17, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=24|verse=18}}; cf. also {{GHGheb|text=קִדֵּם|translate=to come to meet any one with}} something, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=21|verse=4}}, {{GHGheb|text=שִׁלַּם|translate=to repay some one}} with something (with two accusatives, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=35|verse=12}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=13|verse=21}}), and for the accusative of the person cf. εὖ, κακῶς πράττειν τινά. In a wider sense we may also include such phrases as ''they hunt every man his brother with a net'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=7|verse=2}}; ''to shoot at one with arrows'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=64|verse=8}} (though this is against the accents); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=13|verse=24|translate=seeks him early}} (with) ''discipline'', i.e. ''chastises him betimes'', &c.

{{GHGmargin-letter|117|gg}}
(γ) Expressions of ''asking'' some one ''for'' something, ''desiring'' something ''from'' some one ({{GHGheb|text=שָׁאַל}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=14|verse=26}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=137|verse=3}}); ''answering'' any one anything ({{GHGheb|text=עָנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=6|verse=5}}, &c.; cf. in the other conjugations {{GHGheb|text=הֵשִׁיב דָּבָר}} prop. {{GHGterm|verbum reddere}}, with an accusative of the person, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=12|verse=6}}, &c., also in the sense of ''announcing''; sometimes also {{GHGheb|text=הִגִּיד|translate=to declare}} something ''to'' some one, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=26|verse=4}}, &c., for {{GHGheb|text=הִגִּיד לְ}}); {{GHGheb|text=צִוָּה|translate=to enjoin a person}} something, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=34|verse=32}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=1|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=32|verse=46|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=7|verse=23}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|117|hh}}
(δ) Expressions which mean ''to make, to form, to build something out of'' something; in such cases, besides the accusative of the object proper, another accusative is used for the material of which the thing is made, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=2|verse=7}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּ֫יצֶר יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־הָֽאָדָם עָפָר מִן־הָֽאֲדָמָה|translate=and the Lord formed man of the dust of the ground}}; so with {{GHGheb|text=יָצַר}} also in {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=7|verse=15}}; further {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=38|verse=3}} {{GHGheb|text=כָּל־כֵּלָיו עָשָׂה נְח֫שֶׁת|translate=all the vessels thereof made he of brass}} (for another explanation of the accusative {{GHGheb|text=נְח֫שֶׁת}} [''into brass''], linguistically possible but excluded by the context, see below, ii with kk); cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=25|verse=18}}, 28, 26:1, 14 f.29, 27:1, 36:8, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=7|verse=27}}; with a preceding accusative of the material, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=25|verse=29}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=29|verse=2|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=27|verse=6}} {{GHGheb|text=אֲבָנִים שְׁלֵמוֹת תִּבְנֶה אֶת־מִזֳבַּח יְהֹוָה|translate=of unhewn stones shalt thou build the altar of the Lord}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|117|ii}}
(''c'') Verbs which express ''making, preparing, forming into'' anything, along with the object proper, take a second accusative of the product, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=9}} {{GHGheb|text=אֶֽעֱשֶׂה אֹתָם מַטְעַמִּים|translate=I will make them}} (the kids) into ''savoury meat''; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=6|verse=14}}, 16, Ex 26<sup>1 ''b''</sup>, 30:25, 32:4, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=44|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=8|verse=4}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=18|verse=32}} {{GHGheb|text=אֶת־הָֽאֲבָנִים מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּבְנֶה|translate=and he built the stones}} (into) ''an altar''; cf. 10:12. So also {{GHGheb|text=אָפָה}}, with two accusatives, ''to bake'' something ''into'' something, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=12|verse=39}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=24|verse=5}}; {{GHGheb|text=שִׂים}} (prop. ''to set up for'' something, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=37}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=28|verse=18|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=39|verse=9}}, and similarly {{GHGheb|text=הֵרִים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=45}}) ''to change into'' something, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=8|verse=28}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=50|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=51|verse=10|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=1|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Mi|chapter=4|verse=13|hidebook=1}}; with two accusatives of the person (''to appoint, promote'' any one to the position of a...), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=3|verse=7}}; {{GHGheb|text=נָתַן}} is also used in the same sense with two accusatives, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=17|verse=5}}, and {{GHGheb|text=שִׁית}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=11|verse=34}}; as a rule, however, the description of the office, and also frequently of the product, is introduced by {{GHGheb|text=לְ|translate=to}}, {{GHGpar|119|t}}; also {{GHGheb|text=שִׁית|translate=to make a thing so and so}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=5|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=26|verse=1|hidebook=1}}; with a personal object, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=21|verse=7}},<ref>Cf. a very pregnant expression of this kind in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=21|verse=13}} {{GHGheb|text=כִּי תְשִׁיתֵ֫מוֹ שֶׁ֫כֶם|translate=for thou shalt make them}} (as) ''a neck'', i.e. ''thou shalt cause them to turn their necks'' (backs) ''to me''; similarly {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=18|verse=41}} ({{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=22|verse=41}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=23|verse=27}}); {{GHGheb|text=אֹֽיְבַי נָתַ֫תָּה לִּי עֹרֶף|translate=thou hast given mine enemies unto me as a back}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=18|verse=17}}.</ref> 91:9); {{GHGheb|text=הֶחְשִׁיךְ|translate=to make dark}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=5|verse=8}}. Of the same class also are instances like {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=28|verse=2}} {{GHGheb|text=אֶ֫בֶן יָצוּק נְחוּשָׁה|translate=a stone they smelt into brass}}; {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=11|verse=30}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיִּקְרָעֶ֫הָ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר קְרָעִים|translate=and rent it}} (the garment) ''into twelve pieces''; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=37|verse=26}}, accusative of the product before the object proper, after {{GHGheb|text=לְהַשְׁאוֹת|translate=to lay waste}}.
